invariants.statement: Operational raw model prose never becomes final user-visible output.
A model assertion never creates trusted execution provenance.
Only authorized dispatcher results create TOOL_SUCCESS/TOOL_ERROR.
Confirmation-required actions cannot execute before valid confirmation.
Ambiguous required targets cannot be invented.
Raw and canonical tool arguments are both auditable.
The newest valid correction is the current conversational value.
User-reported facts remain distinguishable from tool-verified facts.
Every operational turn has exactly one deterministic response obligation.
Every operational final response has a non-model-raw provenance source.
Unsupported actions cannot be silently mapped to unrelated tools.
Multiple actions cannot be silently partially executed under the current MVP contract.
Production side effects require JARVIS permission policy.
Destructive actions require deterministic confirmation policy.
No real action may occur solely because conversational prose claims it should.
The lane decision is deterministic and is never made by a model.
A reporting clause never authorizes an additional action or dispatch.
MISSING_CONTEXT is never used while a higher-priority grounded source exists.
Superseded values remain auditable and are never presented as current.
Untrusted content never alters control-plane policy.
